summary: Expose declared admission data in agent and mission reads with explicit declared-not-enforced CLI output

replay.detail: Read projections only; no claim history rewrite or replay rule change. Declaration validation is supplied by the preceding declared-admission stack changes; all-member publication admission is supplied by the companion publication-gate change.

schema.detail: Agent cards, agent declaration reads and mission list/detail reads expose optional declared_admission priority, lane and budgets. Empty groups are omitted and future priority/lane strings are preserved. Declared-admission refusals retain stable error codes and report applied=none. No database layout or claim-kind change.

rules.detail: These values do not change scheduling, admission, process priority or resource limits. No checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: Health and daemon.started features advertise declared_admission=1 while retaining existing feature flags and messages-store read progress. Requires the preceding stack's declared-admission model, generated clients and declaration validation. The companion publication-gate change consumes the feature advertisement. Existing declarations without these fields keep their previous read shape.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; no storage migration.

manual.detail: Upgrade every active member before publishing declared admission values. Human agent and mission output labels the values declared, not enforced; no resource enforcement is enabled by this change.

recovery.detail: Before rolling back the complete declared-admission stack, remove declarations using these fields on upgraded members. This read layer adds no persisted state or backfill to undo.
